messages:
zoe: Noticed increased SCIM 400s at 11:04 UTC for multiple tenants. Error: "failed to decrypt externalId". Sample from logs:
```
level=error svc=scim msg="provision user failed" err="KMSInvalidEnvelope: tag mismatch" tenant=acme-corp trace=ac-77b1
```

kai: tagging ops. Did we push any RBAC or secret rotations overnight?

nina: we rotated service account perms for scim-worker to remove write on /secrets/legacy at 02:15 but didn't touch KMS. No metadata or RBAC changes for SSO.

ops-oncall: rolling root cause: earlier KMS rotation script updated key alias to redwood-sso-v3 but left a fallback alias redwood-sso still in accounts; some workers use env var KMS_ALIAS, others read the secret path.

zoe: that's consistent: scim-worker in prod reads /var/secrets/sso/kms_alias (file) mounted from secret v2 which still points to redwood-sso (old). New envelope tags are v3 -> tag mismatch.

kms-bot: Automated KMS rotation completed 2026-03-05T02:00:00Z. New primary_alias=redwood-sso-v3, previous_alias=redwood-sso

kai: immediate mitigation: can we enable decryption with both aliases for a short window? Ops can reconfigure keystore policy to allow decrypt using previous alias via alias chaining.

ops-oncall: temp change made: added alias redwood-sso -> redwood-sso-v3 fallback. Confirmed decrypt works for test artifact.

nina: after ops change, scim provisioning resumed for ~60% of failing tenants. We still see SAML logins failing with audience validation for tenants behind the new edge host header rewrite. Example assertion fragment:
```
<Audience>https://platform.acme.internal/</Audience>
```
Our SP metadata lists https://auth.redwood.com/ only.

zoe: who rolled the host rewrite? @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: that was part of edge routing update to support customer vanity domains. We rewrote host header to tenant-specific host. Didn't realize SAML audiences would be affected.

kai: action items: 1) add alternate Audience entries to SP metadata for tenant hostnames 2) update edge rewrite to preserve original Host for SAML endpoints 3) patch scim-worker to read KMS_ALIAS from env first and fallback to secret file 4) add integration test for KMS rotation 5) audit log entry for rotation and services impacted 6) create alert for KMSInvalidEnvelope errors

nina: also discovered RBAC side-effect: the scim-worker lost access to audit-log:write after the perms change, so we have gaps in prov events between 02:00-11:00. Need to backfill those for compliance.

zoe: creating compliance ticket for backfill and emailing security-legal. We must keep an immutable record of who rotated keys and which services failed.

ops-oncall: follow-up: will schedule a canary for host rewrite change and add a feature flag to preserve host on /saml/acs route.

kms-bot: Note: Recommend running re-encrypt job for blobs encrypted with previous alias to normalize envelope tag. See runbook KMS-rotations/v2.md

kai: vuln triage note: although this was operational, the lack of automated config propagation for KMS alias is a control gap. Filing vuln-triage: VT-2026-11. Mitigation: centralize alias in a single vault secret and require deploy pipelines to fetch live secret during rollout.

nina: quick patch deployed: scim-worker v1.4.2 reads KMS_ALIAS from env *and* secret, logs both sources and fails loudly if mismatch across nodes. Pushed canary to prod.

zoe: monitoring: added a log-based metric for "KMSInvalidEnvelope" and an alert threshold of 5 occurrences/min across prod. Also created dashboard tile for SAML AudienceMismatch counts by tenant.

ops-oncall: incident set P1 initially; de-escalated to P2 after fallback alias and scim fix. Leaving ticket open until audit backfill and metadata updates done.

zoe: thanks everyone. I'll assemble postmortem draft with timeline, root cause, impact table, and action owners. last check 11:08 UTC.
